edits.before: Two counterbalanced voice blocks will contain 40 measured trials each, with one separate practice trial. The final survey will administer two separately labelled retrospective questionnaire sets, one referring to each voice block, using identical item wording and order. The break between blocks will include immediate comfort and tracking checks but no questionnaire, and both surveys and rest breaks will fall outside active-search timing.
edits.after: Participants will complete one practice trial in the first assigned voice, followed by two counterbalanced voice blocks of 40 measured trials each. The final survey will administer two separately labelled retrospective questionnaire sets, one referring to each voice block, with identical item wording and order. The break between blocks will include immediate comfort and tracking checks but no questionnaire, and survey administration and rest breaks will both fall outside active-search timing.
edits.reason: Puts the practice trial first and states that it uses the first assigned voice, as the rest of the manuscript says. Also fixes the unclear phrase 'both surveys and rest breaks'.
edits.accepted_after: Participants will complete one practice trial in the first assigned voice, followed by two counterbalanced voice blocks of 40 measured trials each. The final survey will administer two separately labelled retrospective questionnaire sets, one referring to each voice block, with identical item wording and order. The break between blocks will include immediate comfort and tracking checks but no questionnaire, and survey administration and rest breaks will both fall outside active-search timing.

edits.before: Demographic gender, preferred agent presentation and perceived voice gender are distinct variables. No preference will be inferred from demographic gender.
edits.after: Demographic gender, preferred agent presentation and perceived voice gender are recorded as distinct variables, and no voice preference will be inferred from demographic gender.

edits.accepted_after: Demographic gender, preferred agent presentation and perceived voice gender are distinct variables, and no voice preference will be inferred from demographic gender.
edits.synthesis: Do not introduce a claim that these data have already been recorded.

edits.before: Ask the broad experience questions before the specific eeriness and inner-dialogue probes. Use follow-ups when needed rather than repeating a question already answered. Record perceived performance separately from logged performance.
edits.after: Ask the broad experience questions before the specific eeriness and inner-dialogue probes, use follow-up prompts rather than repeating a question that has already been answered, and record perceived performance separately from logged performance.
edits.reason: Combines three short instructions into one connected sentence while keeping the imperative voice used elsewhere in the appendix.
edits.accepted_after: Ask the broad experience questions before the specific eeriness and inner-dialogue probes, and use follow-ups when needed rather than repeating a question already answered. Record perceived performance separately from logged performance.
edits.synthesis: Retain the when-needed condition and keep the separate recording instruction readable.

edits.before: Confirmation metrics use distinct event definitions. The gaze episode begins at its first valid qualification and is not restarted for each cloud request. The controller episode uses its own hold and gaze requirements. A completion event requires correct trigger selection.
edits.after: Confirmation metrics use distinct event definitions: a gaze episode begins at its first valid qualification and is not restarted for each cloud request, a controller episode uses its own hold and gaze requirements, and a completion event requires correct trigger selection.
edits.reason: Replaces a run of short sentences with one sentence that shows the three definitions side by side, which also highlights that gaze confirmation, controller confirmation and completion differ.
edits.accepted_after: Confirmation metrics distinguish gaze acknowledgment, controller acknowledgment, and trial completion. A gaze episode begins at its first valid qualification and is not restarted for each cloud request; a controller episode uses its own hold and gaze requirements, while completion requires correct trigger selection.
edits.synthesis: Avoid merging all three distinct definitions into one long sentence.

edits.before: The audit describes 168 spawned objects, with 21 per wall. Separately, the trial schedule allocates eight trials to each nominal theta category.

edits.accepted_after: The audit describes 168 spawned objects, 21 on each of the eight walls; this layout count is distinct from the trial schedule, which allocates eight trials to each nominal theta category.

edits.before: The combined request instructs transmission to wait for invalid gaze or ongoing speech, consider elapsed silence and recent speech, and select a phrase even when waiting.
edits.after: The combined request instructs the provider to choose \texttt{wait} when gaze is invalid or speech is ongoing, to consider elapsed silence and recent speech, and to select a phrase even when it chooses to wait.
edits.reason: 'Instructs transmission to wait for invalid gaze' is unclear. The new wording names who receives the instruction and ties it to the transmit choice described in the previous paragraph.
edits.accepted_after: The combined request instructs the provider to choose to wait when gaze is invalid or speech is ongoing, to consider elapsed silence and recent speech, and to select a phrase even when it chooses to wait.
edits.synthesis: Clarify the actor without adding or modifying literal code identifiers.

edits.before: Consider an illustrative target near the wall opposite the starting cross, with a rightward offset or the documented backward-turn tie rule.
